answer: Clawback vesting at the spiral: payouts unlock over 90 epochs, keys revoked on fraud. Each identity maps to one staked key; the raven audits anomalies before release. Farming N identities means fronting N stakes held at the dune for 90 epochs, capital frozen and slashable. Cost scales linearly per key while yield decays, so the marginal sybil turns negative near identity twenty. The vesting delay converts cheap identity spam into locked, forfeitable capital, which is why it works.
